verses.greek: Ταύτην ἤδη, ἀγαπητοί, δευτέραν ὑμῖν γράφω ἐπιστολήν, ἐν αἷς διεγείρω ὑμῶν ἐν ὑπομνήσει τὴν εἰλικρινῆ διάνοιαν,
verses.literal: This now beloved is the second to you I am writing letter in which I am stirring up of you in putting you in remembrance the pure mind
verses.dgt: Beloved, this is now the second letter I am writing to you. In both I stir up your sincere mind by way of reminder,

verses.greek: μνησθῆναι τῶν προειρημένων ῥημάτων ὑπὸ τῶν ἁγίων προφητῶν καὶ τῆς τῶν ἀποστόλων ὑμῶν ἐντολῆς τοῦ κυρίου καὶ σωτῆρος,
verses.literal: remembering the spoken beforehand declarations — by the holy prophets and of the the apostles of you commandment of the Lord and Savior
verses.dgt: so that you remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets and the commandment of the Lord and Savior through your apostles.

verses.greek: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι ἐλεύσονται ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐν ἐμπαιγμονῇ ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι
verses.literal: this first knowing that they will come in these last of the days with scoffing scoffers according to the their own evil desires of them following
verses.dgt: Know this first: in the last days scoffers will come with scoffing, walking according to their own desires

verses.greek: καὶ λέγοντες· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ; ἀφʼ ἧς γὰρ οἱ πατέρες ἐκοιμήθησαν, πάντα οὕτως διαμένει ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως.
verses.literal: and saying Where is the promise of the coming of Him? From the time that for the fathers fell asleep all things as they were continue from the beginning of creation.
verses.dgt: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For since the fathers fell asleep, all things remain just as they were from the beginning of creation.”

verses.greek: λανθάνει γὰρ αὐτοὺς τοῦτο θέλοντας ὅτι οὐρανοὶ ἦσαν ἔκπαλαι καὶ γῆ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ διʼ ὕδατος συνεστῶσα τῷ τοῦ θεοῦ λόγῳ,
verses.literal: It is concealed from indeed them this willingly that heavens were existing long ago and the earth out of water and through water having been composed by the the of God word
verses.dgt: For they deliberately overlook this: heavens existed long ago, and earth was formed out of water and through water by the word of God,

verses.greek: διʼ ὧν ὁ τότε κόσμος ὕδατι κατακλυσθεὶς ἀπώλετο·
verses.literal: through means of those waters the at that time world with water having been deluged perished.
verses.dgt: through which the world at that time was destroyed, being flooded with water.

verses.greek: οἱ δὲ νῦν οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ τῷ αὐτῷ λόγῳ τεθησαυρισμένοι εἰσὶν πυρὶ τηρούμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως καὶ ἀπωλείας τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνθρώπων.
verses.literal: the But now the heavens and the earth by the same word stored up they are for fire being kept unto the day of judgment and destruction the of ungodly men.
verses.dgt: But by the same word the present heavens and earth are stored up for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly people.

verses.greek: Ἓν δὲ τοῦτο μὴ λανθανέτω ὑμᾶς, ἀγαπητοί, ὅτι μία ἡμέρα παρὰ κυρίῳ ὡς χίλια ἔτη καὶ χίλια ἔτη ὡς ἡμέρα μία.
verses.literal: This one however thing not should be hidden from you beloved that one day with the Lord is like a thousand years and a thousand years like day one.
verses.dgt: But do not let this one thing escape you, beloved: with the Lord one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.

verses.greek: οὐ βραδύνει κύριος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ὥς τινες βραδύτητα ἡγοῦνται, ἀλλὰ μακροθυμεῖ εἰς ὑμᾶς, μὴ βουλόμενός τινας ἀπολέσθαι ἀλλὰ πάντας εἰς μετάνοιαν χωρῆσαι.
verses.literal: Not does delay Lord the promise as some slowness esteem but is patient toward you not willing for any to perish but all to repentance to come.
verses.dgt: The Lord is not slow concerning the promise, as some consider slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing any to perish but all to come to repentance.

verses.greek: ἥξει δὲ ἡμέρα κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης, ἐν ᾗ οἱ οὐρανοὶ ῥοιζηδὸν παρελεύσονται, στοιχεῖα δὲ καυσούμενα λυθήσεται, καὶ γῆ καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα εὑρεθήσεται.
verses.literal: Will come however day of the Lord like a thief in which the heavens with a roar will pass away elements then burning with heat it will be dissolved and the earth and the in it works will be exposed.
verses.dgt: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, in which the heavens will pass away with a roar, the elements will be dissolved by burning, and the earth and the works in it will be found.

verses.greek: Τούτων οὕτως πάντων λυομένων ποταποὺς δεῖ ὑπάρχειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ἁγίαις ἀναστροφαῖς καὶ εὐσεβείαις,
verses.literal: When these things in this way all being dissolved what kind ought to be you In holy conduct and in godliness
verses.dgt: Since all these things are being dissolved in this way, what kind of people ought you to be in holy conduct and godliness,

verses.greek: προσδοκῶντας καὶ σπεύδοντας τὴν παρουσίαν τῆς τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμέρας, διʼ ἣν οὐρανοὶ πυρούμενοι λυθήσονται καὶ στοιχεῖα καυσούμενα τήκεται·
verses.literal: expecting and hastening the coming of the the of God day through which the heavens being set on fire will be dissolved and the elements burning with heat are melting?
verses.dgt: waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be dissolved by fire and the elements will melt as they burn?

verses.greek: καινοὺς δὲ οὐρανοὺς καὶ γῆν καινὴν κατὰ τὸ ἐπάγγελμα αὐτοῦ προσδοκῶμεν, ἐν οἷς δικαιοσύνη κατοικεῖ.
verses.literal: New however heavens and earth a new according to the promise of Him we are awaiting in which righteousness dwells.
verses.dgt: But according to his promise we wait for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

verses.greek: Διό, ἀγαπητοί, ταῦτα προσδοκῶντες σπουδάσατε ἄσπιλοι καὶ ἀμώμητοι αὐτῷ εὑρεθῆναι ἐν εἰρήνῃ,
verses.literal: Therefore beloved these things expecting do be diligent without spot and without blemish by Him to be found in peace
verses.dgt: Therefore, beloved, while waiting for these things, be diligent to be found by him spotless and blameless, in peace,

verses.greek: καὶ τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μακροθυμίαν σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθε, καθὼς καὶ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἡμῶν ἀδελφὸς Παῦλος κατὰ τὴν δοθεῖσαν αὐτῷ σοφίαν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν,
verses.literal: And the of the Lord of us patience as salvation do esteem even as also the beloved of us brother Paul according to the having been given to him wisdom wrote to you
verses.dgt: and regard the patience of our Lord as salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you according to the wisdom given to him,

verses.greek: ὡς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐπιστολαῖς λαλῶν ἐν αὐταῖς περὶ τούτων, ἐν αἷς ἐστιν δυσνόητά τινα, ἃ οἱ ἀμαθεῖς καὶ ἀστήρικτοι στρεβλοῦσιν ὡς καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς γραφὰς πρὸς τὴν ἰδίαν αὐτῶν ἀπώλειαν.
verses.literal: as also in all the letters speaking in them concerning these things among which letters are difficult to be understood some things which the ignorant and unestablished distort as also the other Scriptures to the own of them destruction.
verses.dgt: as also in all his letters, speaking in them about these things. In them are some things hard to understand, which the ignorant and unstable twist, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς οὖν, ἀγαπητοί, προγινώσκοντες φυλάσσεσθε ἵνα μὴ τῇ τῶν ἀθέσμων πλάνῃ συναπαχθέντες ἐκπέσητε τοῦ ἰδίου στηριγμοῦ,
verses.literal: you yourselves therefore beloved knowing this beforehand do beware that not by the of the lawless error having been led away you may fall from the your own steadfastness
verses.dgt: Therefore you, beloved, knowing this beforehand, guard yourselves so that you are not carried away by the error of lawless people and fall from your own stability,

verses.greek: αὐξάνετε δὲ ἐν χάριτι καὶ γνώσει τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ. αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς ἡμέραν αἰῶνος. ἀμήν.
verses.literal: do grow however in grace and in knowledge of the Lord of us and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity Amen.
verses.dgt: but grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
